message: [condition] strategy report preview condition 'P_CROSS_ROW' holds 2 closes in a row on 'custom:0b7f688e-045d-8dff-84fb-0885d958e4ca.RSI14', but it reads a transition — a change that fires on one bar — so it can be held "within 194 closes" only, never on 2 or more of them.
